verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a transcription API, which could offer batch job submission or bulk cancel/read. The evidence only documents single-job creation (one URL or one uploaded file per job), per-job status reads, and per-job MCP tools such as cancel_job. The Google Drive/Zapier integrations automate transcription file by file, which is an adjacent workaround rather than a documented bulk capability, so it earns no credit.
